categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of corrugated cardboard and corrugated boxes. It produces corrugated base paper at its Osan plant and corrugated boxes and sheets at its Anseong, Yangsan, and Daejeon plants. Additionally, it engages in real estate sales and leasing, import-export, and waste disposal businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses an integrated production system from raw material (base paper) manufacturing to corrugated sheets and boxes. Production involves large-scale water usage and drying processes, with energy-intensive operations consuming significant electricity and fuel. It employs automated production lines with ERP logistics systems for precise inventory and order management, ensuring timely delivery and cost efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves industrial packaging markets, including food packaging, electronics, and textiles, with a focus on domestic customers. Its products are used for packaging agricultural and marine products and e-commerce shipments. The demand is sensitive to consumer market trends and GDP growth, with increasing demand driven by e-commerce expansion and substitution of polystyrene packaging with corrugated boxes.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in South Korea with manufacturing plants located in Osan, Anseong, Yangsan, Daejeon, and a subsidiary in Nonsan. The company primarily serves the domestic market, with minimal export sales. It plans to expand competitiveness in central and northeastern regions of Korea through new plant investments.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates an upstream to midstream integrated supply chain, producing raw corrugated base paper and converting it into corrugated sheets and boxes. It supplies its subsidiary entirely with base paper and also procures raw materials such as pulp and recycled paper from domestic and international suppliers, positioning itself as a vertically integrated manufacturer in the corrugated packaging industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on cost reduction and stable production through integrated manufacturing and advanced ERP systems. It emphasizes environmental management and energy efficiency, including waste heat recovery and pollution control. While no specific R&D activities are reported, the company is preparing to enter e-commerce retailing to increase sales and is investing in new production facilities to enhance regional competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of corrugated boxes and sheets, with 100% of sales from corrugated packaging products. Sales are mostly domestic, conducted on a made-to-order basis with cash or promissory note payment terms. The company also earns interest income from increased deposits and engages in some export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading integrated producer of corrugated base paper and boxes in South Korea, with a competitive advantage due to its vertical integration and rapid supply capability. Market share data is unavailable, but the company competes by maintaining high product quality, cost competitiveness, and superior delivery performance compared to smaller specialized box manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately 312.3 billion KRW, a decrease of 8.5% from the previous year, with operating profit of about 22.9 billion KRW, down 10.9%. Total assets stood at 357 billion KRW with a stable debt ratio of 20.7%. The company maintains a high production capacity utilization rate (~95%) and has a stable financial position with steady profitability despite recent domestic consumption downturns.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a unique value proposition through its integrated production system enabling fast and reliable supply of corrugated base paper and boxes, reducing costs and inventory risks. Its products are environmentally friendly, recyclable alternatives to plastic packaging, with strong compressive strength and cushioning properties. Advanced ERP and logistics systems ensure precise order fulfillment and customer satisfaction with shortened delivery times.
